BiblicalUsage: Yeçud is a foundation in the figurative sense, a beginning. Ezra says that on the first day of the first month he began to go up from Babylon, and the beginning of his journey was according to the good hand of his God upon him.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe every beginning that is God's is a foundation, and Ezra's journey began in His hand.
